summary_1line: Rama returns to Ayodhya, is crowned king, dismisses allies, and Markandeya uses his trials to encourage Yudhishthira not to despair.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bharata, clothed in rags and smeared with dust, sits before Rama’s sandals until the returning Rama embraces him at Nandigrama.
Rama rides the flying Pushpaka chariot with Sita beside him, pointing out the forests below as they travel toward Ayodhya.
Vasishtha and Vamadeva crown Rama king of Ayodhya under the Sravana star while allies and citizens gather in celebration.
